item.title: A 17-year-old from Gurugram builds Visionably, an AI tool that makes bank statements and textbooks readable for blind people
item.description: It tags PDFs so screen readers can read them, and it is making children's books accessible for free.

item.title: 'Forever chemicals' in England's rivers drop about 30% over a decade, with even bigger falls in fish
item.description: Bans on two of the most harmful PFAS are clearly working, Environment Agency tests show.

item.title: China's carbon emissions fall 3.1% in the third quarter, the biggest drop since Covid, as EVs hit two-thirds of car sales
item.description: Clean power grew twice as fast as electricity demand, pushing coal and oil use down.

item.title: 63 countries have now eliminated at least one neglected tropical disease, and Guinea worm fell to a record-low 10 human cases
item.description: The number of people needing treatment for these diseases is down 36% since 2010, the WHO says.

item.title: An Italian farmer plants old seeds found in his attic and revives an ancient 'miracle wheat' that needs less water and fertiliser
item.description: One seed grew seven ears of grain. Now the flour is on sale.

item.title: A Mumbai museum has taught more than 9,000 children about AI through games, 54% of them girls
item.description: The Museum of Solutions' AI Explorers programme works with government schools across six Maharashtra districts.

item.title: Eternal says its 100% EV delivery fleet by 2030 'doesn't look feasible' now that Zomato and Blinkit have 12 lakh riders
item.description: The parent of Zomato and Blinkit is redrawing its electric-fleet promise. 2035 is being discussed, but no new date is final.

item.title: 'Stand with Jensen': 160,000+ sign a petition to bring Jensen Huang back to Nvidia, as Musk backs it and Bessent says hire an outsider
item.description: Four days after he quit, Silicon Valley is split over whether Nvidia's founder should return, a day before the chipmaker's results.

item.title: Ola fined ₹10 lakh by consumer watchdog CCPA for pushing riders to 'tip' before a driver accepts the ride
item.description: The regulator called Ola's pre-ride 'tip' and 'add-on' prompts a dark pattern and ordered the feature switched off immediately.

item.title: India defend just 209 to beat New Zealand by 22 runs and win the ODI series 3-1; Arshdeep takes 3 for 30
item.description: It is New Zealand's first home ODI series defeat in seven years.

item.title: SpaceX catches a Starship with its launch tower after an orbital flight for the first time; the ship deployed 26 Starlink satellites
item.description: The 'chopsticks' caught the upper stage, but the Super Heavy booster was lost in the Gulf.

item.title: Anthropic's $1.4 trillion IPO comes with a $901 billion question: about $452 billion of compute bills fall due by 2030
item.description: Revenue is soaring, but the Claude maker's spending commitments are just as eye-watering.

item.title: Lakshya Sen comes from a game down to beat Koki Watanabe and become the first Indian to win the Kumamoto Masters
item.description: It is his second Super 500 title in a row and boosts his bid for the World Tour Finals.

item.title: Bay of Bengal depression set to become a cyclone today and a severe cyclonic storm by 17 November; pre-cyclone watch for Andhra and south Odisha
item.description: The IMD has warned of heavy rain and told fishermen to stay off the sea through the week.

item.title: James Murdoch and Uday Shankar's Bodhi Tree buys a majority of sweets chain Adyar Ananda Bhavan (A2B) for $180 million
item.description: The deal values the Chennai chain, which started as a sweet shop in 1979, at about $350 million.

item.title: EaseMyTrip's Q2 loss shrinks 98% to ₹57 lakh as hotel revenue nearly triples; its CMO resigns a year after joining
item.description: Hotels and holidays are carrying the travel platform as air-ticket revenue falls.

item.title: Kids' brand Aretto's 'growing shoes' fit three sizes in one pair; it now targets a ₹100 crore run rate by mid-2027
item.description: The Pune brand has sold over 4 lakh pairs and gets about 40% of its discovery from Instagram.

item.title: KL Rahul invests in sports retail startup PlayBlue as it opens a 20,000 sq ft flagship store in Bengaluru
item.description: The cricketer is also the brand's ambassador; PlayBlue plans 100+ stores in five years.

item.title: Delhi chip startup Bharat Semi raises a $24 million seed round to build AI image sensors for global customers
item.description: Info Edge, South Park Commons and Indus Bridge Ventures led the all-equity round.

item.title: Apple launches a research app to study how people use AI for health questions
item.description: The year-long study, built with OpenEvidence, gives answers grounded in medical journals.

item.title: Italy fines Meta a record €805 million for letting Facebook's Android app reach users' photos without specific consent
item.description: It is the biggest fine ever issued by Italy's privacy regulator; about 20 million users were affected.

item.title: Parliament's Winter Session likely in the first week of December; the women's quota–delimitation bill would need about 361 votes
item.description: The government is weighing a fresh session or reconvening the Monsoon Session, which was never formally closed.

item.title: PM Modi launches 246 tribal development projects worth ₹3,000 crore on Janjatiya Gaurav Divas
item.description: The projects, marking Birsa Munda's birth anniversary, include 38 new Eklavya model residential schools.

item.title: Yemen's Houthis advance to within 60 km of Aden as the government fortifies the city; 600 detainees freed
item.description: Military sources say the rebels have taken two districts in Lahj province.

item.title: A third US aircraft carrier arrives in the Middle East as Bahrain says it intercepted Iranian drones
item.description: Iran also rejected Germany's demand to halt uranium enrichment.

item.title: Trump, Xi and Putin's first three-way meeting in Shenzhen will focus on nuclear arms; the US says it expects no deal
item.description: The leaders meet on the sidelines of APEC this week; Ukraine is not on Trump's list.

item.title: Cape Verde re-elects President José Maria Neves with 63.8% of the vote, provisional results show
item.description: His main challenger, Joana Rosa Amado, was the country's first woman presidential candidate.

item.title: Pope Leo draws about 100,000 to a Mass in Peru's Amazon city of Pucallpa, calling for protection of the forest and its people
item.description: He wraps up his South America tour in Lima and flies back to Rome on 17 November.

item.title: Markets this week: FPIs have bought ₹84,290 crore of Indian shares in November; WPI inflation, Nvidia results and Nifty expiry ahead
item.description: GIFT Nifty pointed to a slightly higher open on Monday after three straight weekly gains.

item.title: IPO week: Crystal Crop opens Wednesday at ₹259–272, and Coal India's Mahanadi Coalfields arm follows on Thursday
item.description: Three issues open this week, including Coal India's sale of about 10% of Mahanadi Coalfields.

item.title: Gold steadies near ₹1.38 lakh per 10 grams after falling about 5% in a week; bitcoin slips to about $64,500
item.description: 24-carat gold in Delhi is down roughly ₹7,000 per 10 grams since 9 November.

item.title: India face Pakistan in the SAFF Championship final on Tuesday, chasing a record 10th title
item.description: It is Pakistan's first-ever SAFF final; India beat them 3-2 in the group stage.

item.title: Women's Asian Champions Trophy hockey starts in Bhopal on 19 November; defending champions India open against Malaysia
item.description: Salima Tete leads a 20-member squad chasing a fourth title.

item.title: Ramayana: Part 1 earns ₹75 crore on its second Sunday, taking its India net total to ₹760.60 crore in 11 days
item.description: It will also release in China, Russia, Japan and South Korea in early 2027.

item.title: New CBFC rules mean films can't announce release dates before certification, says producer Dil Raju
item.description: Final cuts now have to reach the censor board about a month before release.

item.title: Airbnb's Brian Chesky gives San Francisco $100 million for parks, the biggest single-donor gift in the city's history
item.description: A new 10-acre waterfront park with a beach is among the first projects.

item.title: World first: bone marrow from a deceased organ donor cures a woman's aplastic anaemia
item.description: Six months on, the 40-year-old no longer needs blood or platelet transfusions.

item.title: A pocket ECG made in Dehradun gives a heart test in minutes and has screened about 5 million people
item.description: Sunfox's Spandan runs off a smartphone, needs no battery or internet, and is used in 20,000+ villages.

item.title: Assam bans drones near Amur falcon roosts as lakhs of the migratory birds stop over
item.description: Forest officers can now declare temporary no-drone zones while the falcons rest.

item.title: A critically endangered spoon-billed sandpiper tagged in Russia turns up on Bengal's coast, about 8,000 km away
item.description: Fewer than 500 of these tiny shorebirds are thought to be left in the wild.

item.title: Sunday clean-ups led by a Moradabad engineer have pulled over 1.2 lakh kg of waste from the Ramganga river
item.description: What started on Earth Day 2018 has grown into 218+ drives with thousands of volunteers.

item.title: An IIT Madras-incubated startup has helped 130+ buildings save 5 billion litres of water by finding hidden leaks
item.description: Chennai's EarthFokus cut one big office campus's daily water demand by nearly 80%.

item.title: A cheap plastic drape that measures blood loss is cutting deaths from childbirth bleeding by about two-thirds
item.description: Maternity wards across Africa are adopting the simple pouch.

item.title: A drone flies food and blankets to a 38-year-old chimp stranded by floods at a Florida sanctuary
item.description: Kaleb was filmed happily pulling a banana out of the paper bag.

item.title: Raj Shamani's 'Figuring Out' becomes the world's most-subscribed YouTube podcast with 22 million subscribers
item.description: The show that started in a small room in Indore has moved past The Diary of a CEO and The Joe Rogan Experience.

item.title: Airtel's Sunil Mittal says mobile bills should rise to ₹350 a month per user, about 29% above Airtel's ₹271 today
item.description: The Bharti chairman says India would 'still be by far the cheapest in the world', a strong hint that another round of tariff hikes is coming at some point.

item.title: 'The best founders are not on Instagram': Bombay Shaving Company's Shantanu Deshpande calls himself a 'mediocre founder'
item.description: One of India's most visible founders told other founders to stop copying reel-making CEOs, and pointed to the leaders of Meesho, Groww, Ather and Lenskart instead.

item.title: Outlook outage turns into a meme fest: Zomato, KitKat, Air India, Canva and Myntra roast Microsoft
item.description: While Outlook and Teams were down for a second workday, brands raced to turn the outage into topical posts.

item.title: Trump, Xi and Putin will hold their first-ever three-way meeting in Shenzhen on 19 November
item.description: The Kremlin confirmed the meeting on the sidelines of APEC; nuclear weapons and the Iran war are on the agenda, Ukraine is not.

item.title: Mumbai CNG goes up ₹1.50 to ₹91.50 a kg from today, the second hike this month
item.description: Mahanagar Gas blamed costlier imported gas; autos, taxis and private cars across the Mumbai region will feel it.

item.title: Centre cracks down on rice hoarding: traders must report stocks every Friday, and govt doubles cheap rice sales to 50 lakh tonnes
item.description: With rice prices up about 12% in a year, the food ministry is pushing more grain into the market and watching who holds it.

item.title: PM Modi heads to Manila on Monday for the ASEAN-India and East Asia summits; a Quad leaders' meeting is likely on 17 November
item.description: It would be the first Quad leaders' summit in about two years; a Modi–Trump meeting is being discussed but isn't confirmed.

item.title: US assures India of a tariff edge over rivals in the trade deal; dairy and GM foods stay off the table
item.description: A senior official says Washington promised India a 'comparative advantage over our competitors', but the final US tariff structure isn't settled.

item.title: Iran says at least three oil tankers, including a supertanker, hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran says the ships had switched off their tracking and used unauthorised routes; the US says it has cleared the main lanes of mines.

item.title: The US reportedly loses its measles-free status after 26 years, with more than 5,400 cases this year
item.description: A regional health commission has revoked the status the US had held since 2000, according to the Wall Street Journal.

item.title: Zelensky says the US floated NATO membership if Ukraine pulls out of Donbas; he says Ukraine isn't ready to give up land
item.description: He called it 'an extremely difficult conversation' and said any final package would have to go to a referendum.

item.title: Carlsberg plans a $600 million India IPO at a $4 billion valuation; the brewer could list as early as January
item.description: India's second-largest brewer is lining up investor meetings, Bloomberg reports, with the parent selling a 15% stake.

item.title: Aamir Khan Productions and Excel Entertainment team up to build a microdrama app
item.description: Two big Bollywood studios are entering India's crowded short-video drama race with professionally made shows.

item.title: Indian startup funding falls about 90% in a week to $25–31 million; Greenjoules' ₹150 crore round is the biggest
item.description: A Diwali-shortened week made for one of the quietest funding stretches in months.

item.title: Noel Tata warns a Tata Sons listing could put 'profit ahead of philanthropy' as friction in the group widens
item.description: The Tata Trusts chairman spoke out as a Voltas chairman change reportedly went ahead without Chandrasekaran being told first.

item.title: FirstCry's Q2 loss shrinks 75% to ₹12.6 crore as revenue rises 14% to ₹2,396 crore
item.description: The kids' products platform is closing in on profit, though rising raw-material costs squeezed its India margins.

item.title: Ajinkya Rahane invests in Italian-made cookware brand Ember, the latest cricketer to back a startup
item.description: The D2C brand sells ceramic and steel cookware made in Italy, and is on quick-commerce apps in four big cities.

item.title: Nvidia reportedly approaches Arm CEO Rene Haas to succeed Jensen Huang, after losing about $573 billion in value in a week
item.description: The Financial Times says the board has made contact; Nvidia says it hasn't formally engaged any candidate.

item.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet so its AI agents can shop and check out for you
item.description: It starts with some US Pro users, works with Visa, Mastercard and Amex, and needs your approval for every purchase.

item.title: Tesla opens Cybercab pre-orders for personal use at $29,990, plus $299 a month
item.description: Deliveries start in December, but only in a handful of Texas cities, and the car drives only inside mapped zones.

item.title: Anthropic's IPO draws orders faster than SpaceX's did, but some investors question how long its AI lead will last
item.description: Reuters says the $64 billion offering was about six times covered by day three, ahead of pricing on 18 November.

item.title: Sensex logs a third straight weekly gain, up 564 points, as Bank Nifty jumps 3.7% and SBI rallies 6.3%
item.description: Despite Friday's fall on high inflation, the Diwali-shortened week ended in the green, led by banks.

item.title: Foreign investors have poured ₹76,189 crore into Indian shares in November so far, after two months of selling
item.description: The buying spree comes as investors shift money away from AI-heavy markets like the US, Korea and Taiwan.

item.title: IPO week: Crystal Crop Protection's ₹455 crore issue opens Wednesday at ₹259–272; Coal India's Mahanadi Coalfields is lined up
item.description: It's the first mainboard IPO after a gap of more than two weeks.

item.title: Lakshya Sen beats Alwi Farhan 21-12, 15-21, 21-11 to become the first Indian in a Kumamoto Masters final
item.description: It's his second final in a row; he faces Japan's Koki Watanabe in the title match today.

item.title: Suryakumar Yadav smashes a 15-ball fifty as Mumbai chase 173 in 13.1 overs in the Syed Mushtaq Ali opener
item.description: Out of the India T20 side, the Mumbai captain answered with 60 not out off 21 balls in Kolkata.

item.title: Portugal lose 4-1 to Denmark in their first game since Cristiano Ronaldo quit international football
item.description: Rasmus Højlund scored twice in Braga on a night that began with tributes to Ronaldo.

item.title: Ramayana: Part 1 earns ₹72.90 crore on its second Saturday, a record, and reaches ₹1,228 crore worldwide in 10 days
item.description: The epic's collections jumped about 52% from Friday, according to Sacnilk.

item.title: IFFI Goa 2026: Dhurandhar opens the Indian Panorama of 76 films in 18 languages; Ramayana opens a new BRICS section
item.description: The 57th film festival runs from 20 to 28 November with films from 86 countries.

item.title: Godzilla Minus Zero gets a U/A 16+ certificate in India despite an R rating abroad; it opens on 20 November
item.description: The censor board passed the 137-minute monster film without an adults-only rating.

item.title: AIIMS Delhi performs India's first open surgery on an unborn baby's spine, at 25 weeks of pregnancy
item.description: A team of 30+ doctors and nurses repaired a severe spinal defect while the baby was still in the womb.

item.title: A tigress and her two cubs stroll out in the open in Kaziranga, where tiger numbers have passed 140
item.description: Safari visitors filmed the rare sight in the park's Kohora range.

item.title: A deep-sea shark mistaken for decades for an Atlantic species is a new one: meet the Indian Bramble Shark
item.description: Indian scientists studied sharks landed in Kollam, Kerala, and found a separate Indian Ocean species.

item.title: A new pink-flowered begonia has been found beside a mountain stream in Arunachal's Upper Siang
item.description: Named Begonia siangensis, it is known from just one spot so far.

item.title: Infosys Prize 2026: six researchers under 40 win $100,000 each, from quantum machines to mitochondrial disease
item.description: The winners work in India and abroad, across six fields.

item.title: A surprise right whale calf takes this season's births to 24, the most since 2009 for a species of about 380
item.description: Researchers spotted the unknown calf swimming beside its mother off Quebec.

item.title: A coyote is the first animal to cross the world's largest wildlife bridge in Los Angeles, before it even opens
item.description: Trail cameras caught it walking over 10 lanes of the 101 Freeway on the $114 million crossing.

item.title: Two remote Marshall Islands atolls are among the last untouched ecosystems on Earth, and their waters are now protected
item.description: Scientists found sea life never recorded in the country before, including two groups that may be new to science.

item.title: Paytm gets RBI's in-principle nod to run wallets again; shares close at ₹1,939.70, about 10% below the ₹2,150 IPO price
item.description: Two and a half years after the Payments Bank crackdown took its wallet away, Paytm is a step closer to getting it back, and its stock is nearly back where it listed.

item.title: Maybelline rewrites its famous 'Maybe she's born with it' tagline after 35 years: it's now 'Maybe. We're born with it.'
item.description: One of advertising's best-known lines just lost a pronoun, and marketers are already debating what the swap says.

item.title: Royal Enfield sells a record 3.77 lakh bikes in a quarter; Eicher's Q2 profit rises 14.9% to ₹1,573 crore
item.description: India's favourite big-bike brand had its best quarter ever, though profit still came in a little below what analysts expected.

item.title: India bowled out for 89 as New Zealand win the 4th ODI by 244 runs; Matt Henry takes six wickets
item.description: India needed one win to seal the series, and crashed inside 27 overs instead. Sunday's final game at the same ground now decides it.

item.title: Domino's UK trolls Manchester United again, with a pizza-box reel after the club sacks Michael Carrick
item.description: The pizza chain has made mocking United a running joke, and its latest post landed within hours of the club's managerial change.

item.title: India's exports jump nearly 30% to $89.99 billion in October; overall trade deficit narrows to $20.09 billion
item.description: Goods exports rose 45% from a year ago, while a strong services surplus kept the combined gap in check.

item.title: India's forex reserves rise $2.49 billion to $719.55 billion as gold holdings climb to $104.8 billion
item.description: Most of the weekly gain came from the higher value of gold, not fresh dollar buying.

item.title: Dubai airport halts SpiceJet check-ins over about ₹35.8 crore in unpaid dues; Dubai–India flights cancelled
item.description: If you hold a SpiceJet ticket from Dubai, check your booking: the airline has been told to rebook passengers and provide hotels.

item.title: After the NEET-UG leak, NTA will build a permanent pool of independent exam observers, including retired armed forces personnel
item.description: Observers will report straight to the testing agency instead of local exam staff, for exams like NEET-UG, JEE Main and CUET.

item.title: Delhi's air turns 'severe' with AQI at 403 on Friday morning; GRAP Stage III curbs stay in force
item.description: The capital's air hovered around the severe mark through the day as winter pollution set in.

item.title: US halts every departing flight nationwide for hours; over 4,000 cancellations and 10,000+ delays
item.description: The FAA blamed a 'telecommunication outage' in air traffic control systems. Officials said there was no sign of foul play.

item.title: Iran says it destroyed a US radar in Bahrain; US Central Command says both Iranian drones were shot down with no damage
item.description: The two sides gave opposite accounts, as Gulf states urge Washington to hold off on wider strikes.

item.title: Europe will join the next round of US-brokered Russia–Ukraine talks; US works toward the 'largest prisoner exchange of the war'
item.description: After meeting Putin, US envoys Witkoff and Kushner flew to Ireland to brief Zelensky.

item.title: Gaza's winter crisis: 150,000 tents are stuck at the borders as dozens of nations urge Israel to ease aid limits
item.description: Rain is flooding tents in Khan Younis, and the UN says about 3.5 lakh displaced people face freezing conditions.

item.title: Tata Motors PV posts record ₹20,400 crore India revenue as EV sales jump 90%, but JLR charges push it into a loss
item.description: The Indian car business, led by the Sierra and EVs, is booming. Jaguar Land Rover is the drag.

item.title: Sachin Tendulkar invests in recycling startup Recykal, which made ₹1,498 crore in revenue last year
item.description: The cricket legend's newest bet is a waste-management platform used by brands like HUL, Samsung and BMW.

item.title: SoftBank sells another 1.65% of Meesho for ₹1,885 crore in a block deal; Fidelity, GIC and Norges Bank buy in
item.description: Big global funds are lining up for India's newly listed consumer internet stocks.

item.title: Razorpay's founders lose a Karnataka High Court bid to quash an SFIO case, ahead of a ₹5,000–6,000 crore IPO
item.description: The case is about loan-app payments from years ago; Razorpay itself is not named as an accused.

item.title: ACKO now puts about 80% of its media spend into creators and connected TV, says its CMO
item.description: The insurance brand has moved away from traditional TV over 18 months, and is preparing for AI search.

item.title: Google puts ₹10 crore into creator-economy startup Rigi at a ₹670 crore valuation
item.description: A small but strategic cheque as India's microdrama and creator-video race heats up.

item.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a faster model it says finishes tasks 2.5x quicker than Gemini 3.8 Flash
item.description: It is rolling out across the Gemini app, Search and developer tools at once, priced at $1.50 per million input tokens.

item.title: Nvidia fallout reaches the US Senate: Commerce Secretary Lutnick to testify on 10 December over AI chip sales to China
item.description: Lawmakers want to know how a Singapore firm bought over $4.8 billion of Nvidia chips that may have reached China.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh signs ₹1.41 lakh crore of deals in a day, led by a 1,400 MW data-centre campus; Agnikul plans orbital data centres in Tirupati
item.description: Visakhapatnam and Tirupati are pitching themselves as hubs for AI data centres and space tech.

item.title: Microsoft 365 outage knocks out Outlook, Teams and Copilot in at least 74 countries for a second workday
item.description: Indian firms including IndiGo and Akasa Air reported disruption; Microsoft says there's no sign of a cyberattack.

item.title: Sensex falls 319 points to 81,592 and Nifty ends at 25,144, snapping a three-day winning streak
item.description: Oil worries and the jump in retail inflation weighed on rate-sensitive stocks; FMCG was the only sector in the green.

item.title: Rupee weakens 21 paise to 94.24 against the dollar as US yields and crude rise
item.description: Hot US inflation data and bets on a December Fed hike lifted the dollar; strong foreign buying limited the fall.

item.title: Wall Street ends mixed: Nasdaq falls 0.91% as Nvidia slides again and US wholesale inflation hits 6.5%
item.description: Tech stocks fell while consumer staples and energy held the Dow up, but all three indices still gained over the week.

item.title: India finish the Dakar Youth Olympics with 10 medals, their second-best haul ever, including first-ever boxing golds
item.description: A small team of 17 athletes brought home medals in seven sports, with several Indian firsts.

item.title: Lakshya Sen beats home player Yushi Tanaka 21-16, 21-15 to reach the Kumamoto Masters semi-finals; Srikanth is out
item.description: India's last player in the draw now faces Indonesia's Alwi Farhan, who has beaten him twice before.

item.title: Ramayana: Part 1 reaches about ₹1,110 crore worldwide in 9 days, with ₹47.85 crore net on its second Friday
item.description: Nitesh Tiwari's epic held strongly on day 9, and its second weekend should push it further.

item.title: Dhanush and Mammootty's Tamil action thriller OM drops its trailer; in cinemas worldwide on 20 November
item.description: The next big Tamil release arrives in a week, with Sai Pallavi also in the cast.

item.title: A Bengaluru teen turned a government school's storage room into a library of over 2,000 books
item.description: Asavari Agrawal, 17, has spent nearly five years of weekends making it happen, and partly paid for it by selling her piano.

item.title: A new scorpion species has been found in Odisha's Similipal Tiger Reserve, the first of its kind recorded in the state
item.description: Named Liocheles similipalensis, it's a reminder of how much of India's wildlife is still undiscovered.

item.title: All five Indian students win medals, including 2 golds, at the Junior Astronomy Olympiad in Thailand
item.description: 104 students from 25 countries competed; every member of India's team came home with a medal.

item.title: An Indian-made 'surgical GPS' has helped in over 20,000 operations across 200+ hospitals
item.description: Bengaluru's HRS Navigation built a cheaper alternative to imported systems, so precise surgery can reach smaller cities.

item.title: A rare Central Asian white stork, from a population of under 2,000, has been spotted at Okhla Bird Sanctuary
item.description: Birdwatchers are flocking to the Yamuna wetland near Noida to see a visitor last recorded in Delhi-NCR in 2019.

item.title: Beavers are back around Loch Ness: a family of six has been released about 500 years after they vanished
item.description: It's the first step in a plan to bring at least 15 beaver families back around the famous Scottish loch.

item.title: China's CO2 emissions fell 3.1% in July–September, the biggest quarterly drop since Covid
item.description: Clean power growth outpaced rising demand, and EVs hit a record 67% of new car sales in September.

item.title: 63 countries have now beaten at least one neglected tropical disease; sleeping sickness cases are down 98% since 1999
item.description: A WHO report shows 36% fewer people need treatment for these diseases than in 2010.

item.title: A baby who had about 110 seizures a day became seizure-free within 30 minutes of an experimental drug in Dubai
item.description: Genome sequencing found the exact faulty gene, letting doctors pick a targeted treatment.

item.title: The SS United States, the fastest liner ever to cross the Atlantic, has been sunk off Florida to become the world's largest artificial reef
item.description: The 990-foot ship will now be a home for corals and fish, and a new site for divers.

item.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO after 33 years; CFO Colette Kress named interim chief
item.description: The man who built the world's most valuable chip company has quit with immediate effect, days after Nvidia's board opened an independent probe.

item.title: Lenskart will give free glasses to 1 lakh children on Children's Day and makes blue-light lenses standard at no extra cost
item.description: On its first anniversary as a listed company, Lenskart's Peyush Bansal shared a 'confession': the problem the company was started to solve is still unsolved.

item.title: James Murdoch and Uday Shankar's Bodhi Tree buys a majority stake in Adyar Ananda Bhavan (A2B) for $180 million
item.description: The 50-year-old Chennai sweets and restaurant chain gets big-name backers and a plan to list on the stock market.

item.title: Ola fined ₹10 lakh by consumer watchdog CCPA for 'advance tip' prompts, told to remove the feature
item.description: The regulator called Ola's request to tip before a ride even starts a 'confirm shaming' dark pattern.

item.title: Retail inflation hits a two-year high of 6.09% in October as food prices jump 8.94%, breaching RBI's 6% ceiling
item.description: Prices are rising faster than the RBI's comfort zone allows, and economists now expect another interest rate hike in December.

item.title: PM Modi says the government absorbed ₹43 of a ₹50-a-litre diesel hike, costing ₹14,000 crore a month
item.description: Speaking in Delhi, the PM said diesel went up only ₹7 a litre even though the war in West Asia sent crude oil soaring.

item.title: Gold falls ₹2,180 per 10 grams in a day to ₹1,39,800, then holds steady on Friday
item.description: A stronger dollar after hot US inflation data pushed gold down, a small relief for wedding-season buyers.

item.title: India now buys more oil from the Gulf than from Russia, for the first time since the Iran war began
item.description: Early November tanker data shows Gulf supplies back at about 2.1 million barrels a day as some Hormuz traffic resumes.

item.title: NPCI's new 'UPI Vyapaar Saksham' scheme will pay banks ₹300 per QR code and ₹750 per soundbox to bring small-town shops onto UPI
item.description: The three-year plan targets shops with turnover up to ₹40 lakh in smaller towns, the Northeast, J&K and Ladakh.

item.title: Putin meets US envoys Witkoff and Kushner for over two hours; talks will continue, but no deal on territory
item.description: Direct US–Russia talks have resumed after a nine-month pause, and Europe is set to join the next round.

item.title: Houthis claim attacks on a Saudi oil pipeline and Yanbu; Brent jumps 3.3% to $95.82
item.description: Saudi Arabia has been sending about 4 million barrels a day through this pipeline to avoid the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Xi Jinping says Taiwan's 'complete reunification' will 'certainly be realised', a week before meeting Trump
item.description: Taiwan said the wording was nothing new, as it tracked 29 Chinese military aircraft and ships near the island.

item.title: COP31 leaders' summit ends in Antalya; the '35 by 35' electrification pledge gets backing from at least 14 countries
item.description: The voluntary target aims to raise electricity's share of energy use to 35% by 2035, but the EU and UK have not signed yet.

item.title: Ola Electric's Q2 revenue falls 39% to ₹421 crore; it shuts company-run stores and moves to dealers
item.description: The loss narrowed to ₹362 crore from a year ago, and the company says supply, not demand, is now its problem.

item.title: Spotify launches audiobooks in India: ₹199 a month for 15 hours of listening, with 3.5 lakh English titles
item.description: A new 'Page Match' feature scans a printed book's barcode and starts the audiobook from the same page.

item.title: Gaming startup Zupee lays off its entire staff; its 'AI pivot' was a cover for shutting down, Inc42 reports
item.description: The Ludo game maker had raised over $120 million and once employed close to 500 people.

item.title: Decathlon India swings to a ₹63 crore profit in FY26 after cutting ad spend by 26%; revenue at ₹4,478 crore
item.description: The sports retailer grew sales 8% while spending less on advertising, and plans 200 stores by 2030.

item.title: Kia plans a second Indian plant in Anantapur, a $2 billion investment with its suppliers
item.description: The new factory will add 2 lakh cars a year and build both fuel and electric vehicles for India and export.

item.title: Meta India's Arun Srinivas names quick commerce and microdramas as its next big ad drivers; 2 lakh creators joined its festive programme
item.description: Over 2 lakh creators made shoppable content for Flipkart and Myntra on Meta's platforms this festive season.

item.title: Anthropic's IPO is about six times oversubscribed; TSMC will put $500 million each into Anthropic and OpenAI
item.description: The Claude maker plans to raise up to $64.4 billion and start trading on Nasdaq on 19 November under the ticker 'ANT'.

item.title: OpenAI will now run its AI models on servers inside India for business customers, starting with GPT-6 Luna
item.description: India joins Australia and Japan as markets where OpenAI keeps API processing and data in the country.

item.title: Google DeepMind's AlphaGenome 2 reads DNA cell by cell and finds disease-causing variants twice as often
item.description: Trained on more than 107 million single-cell profiles, it predicts how a DNA change affects genes in a specific tissue.

item.title: Sensex ends 32 points higher at 81,911, Nifty at 25,299, for a third straight gain; realty stocks jump nearly 4%
item.description: Foreign buying held the market up in a choppy session, while smaller stocks did better than the big names.

item.title: Rupee slips 33 paise to 94.04 against the dollar as US rate-hike bets grow, despite strong foreign buying
item.description: A day after hitting its strongest level since April, the rupee gave up ground to a firmer dollar.

item.title: Wall Street slips 0.4% as Nvidia's CEO quits and oil jumps; small caps fall 1.7%
item.description: All three main US indexes ended lower on Thursday as bond yields rose and investors priced in more Fed tightening.

item.title: India lose 5-0 to New Zealand in Auckland; goalkeeper Vishal Kaith saves a penalty
item.description: India have now scored 2 and conceded 16 in four friendlies; the teams meet again in Christchurch on Sunday.

item.title: Vivaan Kapoor wins trap silver at the shooting World Championships and India's first shotgun quota for LA 2028
item.description: In his first senior World Championship final, the 24-year-old from Jaipur lost gold only in a shoot-off.

item.title: Manipur's Ambekar Meetei wins India's first-ever Youth Olympic Games boxing gold
item.description: He beat Ireland's Kristian Jubani on a 3-2 split decision in the men's 50kg final.

item.title: Kidambi Srikanth stuns world No. 8 Kodai Naraoka; he and Lakshya Sen reach the Kumamoto Masters quarter-finals
item.description: Srikanth won a 60-minute three-setter, while Lakshya needed just two games to go through.

item.title: Jailer 2 now streams on Prime Video in 5 languages; Vibe, Mrigaya 1.5 and Bandra also land this weekend
item.description: Rajinikanth's record-breaking film came to OTT exactly four weeks after its cinema release.

item.title: Ramayana: Part 1 crosses ₹1,000 crore worldwide in 8 days, according to Sacnilk
item.description: Ranbir Kapoor and Yash's epic made ₹53.5 crore net in India on its eighth day alone.

item.title: Suriya's Scene crosses ₹200 crore worldwide; he becomes the first Tamil actor with three ₹200-crore films in a year
item.description: The film joins Karuppu and Vishwanathan & Sons, though Ramayana is now taking away screens.

item.title: Five new tiny horned frog species found in Arunachal, including India's first snail-eating frog
item.description: Scans revealed whole snail shells inside one species, the first known snail-eater in its frog family.

item.title: Assam bans drones over Amur falcon roosts as more than 1 lakh of the tiny raptors arrive
item.description: The birds stop in the Northeast on one of the longest migrations of any bird of prey.

item.title: Tamil Nadu's simple TB check cut deaths by at least 38%, and by 56% in the latest group
item.description: Five quick checks at diagnosis send the sickest patients straight to hospital.

item.title: Delhi head constable traces 119 missing children in a year and reunites them with their families
item.description: Head Constable Chanchal of Jaitpur police station also found 16 missing adults.

item.title: An engineer's Sunday clean-ups have pulled over 1.2 lakh kg of waste out of the Ramganga in Moradabad
item.description: Over 218 drives, more than 5,000 volunteers have joined Kapil Kumar to clean the river.

item.title: Antarctic blue whales have grown from about 418 to over 4,000 since whaling ended
item.description: The population of the largest animal ever is growing about 4.5% a year, though it is still critically endangered.

item.title: Spain's Cantabrian brown bears have bounced back from about 140 to 370
item.description: Bigger protected areas and tough fines helped two long-separated bear groups meet again.

item.title: China switches on the world's largest liquid-air energy storage plant, storing 10 hours of power
item.description: It freezes air into liquid with spare solar power and turns it back into electricity when needed.

item.title: Kazakhstan's North Aral Sea is filling up again: water volume is up 24% since 2022 and fish have returned
item.description: A dam and replanting have helped revive part of a sea once called one of the worst environmental disasters.

item.title: Amul and Mother Dairy raise milk prices by up to ₹4 a litre from today; Mother Dairy full cream now ₹76
item.description: India's two biggest milk brands have both raised prices from Thursday, 12 November, citing higher costs for fodder, feed, fuel and packaging.

item.title: Gaurav Munjal steps down as Unacademy CEO after a decade; Akhilendra Kumar takes over, two months after the $200 million upGrad sale
item.description: The co-founder becomes executive chairman of the edtech he started as a YouTube channel in 2015, once valued at $3.4 billion.

item.title: Nvidia's board meets to decide Jensen Huang's future; the chipmaker has lost about $600 billion in value this week
item.description: Shares fell about 8.6% in late trading after a Wall Street Journal report that the board was preparing to remove the CEO who has run Nvidia for 33 years.

item.title: Kunal Shah lists his 3 priorities as WhatsApp head, and users flood his post with spam complaints
item.description: The CRED founder, now global head of WhatsApp, wants more chat features, payments and AI. Users say business spam is the real problem.

item.title: Dior's 'hand-drawn' holiday ad gets called out for six-fingered hands; director admits software filled in frames
item.description: Viewers spotted extra fingers and a shape-shifting dog collar in the luxury brand's 7-minute animated film. The director denies using generative AI.

item.title: Shops sold up to 20% fewer smartphones this Diwali as prices rose about 21%; Realme volumes fell over 50%
item.description: Buyers who did shop went for costlier phones from Apple, Google and Xiaomi, while the budget segment took the biggest hit, says the mobile retailers' body.

item.title: IPO-bound Cult.fit faces a co-founder's forgery claim over the 'CULT' trademark ahead of its ₹4,000 crore listing
item.description: A co-founder of the original CULT gym has asked the Madras High Court to cancel the trademark, alleging the 2017 transfer papers were forged.

item.title: GoKwik staff could lose vested ESOPs if they join any of 9 rivals, including Razorpay and CRED
item.description: An Inc42 investigation found the checkout startup added a non-compete clause to its stock option plan that lasts two years after an employee leaves.

item.title: Customs holds Diageo and Pernod Ricard Scotch at ports, seeking 150% duty instead of the 75% in the India–UK deal
item.description: Officials say bulk Scotch is a 'compound alcoholic preparation', not whisky, so the trade deal's lower duty should not apply.

item.title: Qualcomm begins layoffs in India, with about 1,000 jobs reportedly at risk
item.description: The first round started at the chipmaker's Bengaluru site and is expected to reach Hyderabad, Delhi-NCR and Chennai.

item.title: Cabinet raises rabi fertiliser subsidy by 64% to ₹62,370 crore so farmers don't pay more
item.description: Higher global fertiliser prices pushed the government to raise per-kg support for non-urea fertilisers for the October–March season.

item.title: Stand-Up India extended to 2031 with a ₹4,111 crore guarantee fund to reach 2.5 lakh more entrepreneurs
item.description: The scheme backs bank loans for women, SC and ST entrepreneurs; the new fund guarantees 85% of each loan.

item.title: New RBI money-transfer rules: walk-in customers can send up to ₹50,000 in cash by NEFT
item.description: The RBI has put all rules for small bank transfers into one document, with new limits and stronger checks against fraud.

item.title: 129 betting websites were blocked on the basis of two fake high court orders, Reuters finds
item.description: The telecom department told internet providers to block the sites after receiving orders attributed to the Rajasthan and Allahabad high courts that the courts never issued.

item.title: Storm Charles: Portugal shuts all of its roughly 8,000 schools and cancels 300+ flights
item.description: It was the first nationwide school closure for a forecast storm in living memory; the storm turned out weaker than feared.

item.title: Russia–Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi end with a big prisoner swap but no peace breakthrough; US envoys meet Putin today
item.description: Zelenskyy says up to 1,000–1,200 prisoners each could be exchanged. Territory and security guarantees remain unresolved.

item.title: Iran denies talks with the US and says the Strait of Hormuz stays shut until its 7 conditions are met
item.description: Security chief Mohsen Rezaei called reports of negotiations 'a pure lie'; the US says its economic pressure is working.

item.title: 'The climate crisis is outrunning us,' UN chief tells COP31 leaders, as most G7 heads stay away
item.description: António Guterres said fossil fuels must 'go the way of the dinosaurs'; the UK was the only G7 country to send its leader to Antalya.

item.title: OpenAI's quarterly revenue crosses $10 billion for the first time, but its loss widens to $10.9 billion
item.description: Business customers buying AI coding tools overtook consumer subscriptions as the ChatGPT maker's biggest source of revenue, documents seen by the WSJ show.

item.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 packs car parts with 96% success in a Mercedes-Benz trial
item.description: The new model lets robots see, follow instructions and act, and is 20–30% faster than the previous version.

item.title: Foreign investors buy ₹12,563 crore of Indian shares in a day; rupee firms to 93.70, its strongest since April
item.description: FPIs have bought about $6.4 billion of Indian equities so far in November, the most in a month since September 2024.

item.title: Sensex jumps 773 points to 81,879 after the Diwali break, its highest close since February; Nifty at 25,255
item.description: Banks and autos led the rally as crude cooled and foreign investors bought heavily.

item.title: Wall Street rallies with the S&P 500 up 1.3%; Brent rises to $92.76 after Iran says its uranium stays home
item.description: Chip stocks led US gains on Wednesday before Nvidia slid after hours; oil climbed on Iran's hard line.

item.title: Niraj Kumar wins 50m rifle 3P bronze in Doha and earns India's first rifle quota for LA 2028
item.description: It is his first individual World Championship medal and takes India's tally in Doha to 10.

item.title: Vaishali, the lowest-rated of 24 players, beats Wesley So and Hans Niemann as Carlsen wins the Total Chess blitz opener
item.description: Magnus Carlsen went unbeaten on 7/9 in Budapest; Arjun Erigaisi was the best-placed Indian.

item.title: Lakshya Sen beats Chi Yu Jen 21-19, 21-18 to reach the Kumamoto Masters second round
item.description: The eighth seed came through a tight opener in Japan as he chases a place at the World Tour Finals.

item.title: India's footballers take on New Zealand in Auckland today, only the third meeting between the sides
item.description: Khalid Jamil's team, ranked 138th, play the first of two friendlies; kick-off is around 11:30 am IST.

item.title: OTT this Friday: Ranabaali on Netflix in 5 languages, plus Student of the Year: After Dark and Parivarik ManuRanjan
item.description: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna's period action film arrives on streaming four weeks after its cinema release.

item.title: Ramayana: Part 1 crosses ₹500 crore net in India in its first week; worldwide gross near ₹935 crore
item.description: Trackers estimate ₹70 crore-plus net on its first Wednesday, as Nitesh Tiwari's epic keeps up a strong run.

item.title: Salman Khan's Galwan war film Maatrubhumi drops its trailer: about 15 million views in a day, in cinemas 4 December
item.description: The film, earlier titled Battle of Galwan, is inspired by the June 2020 clash between Indian and Chinese troops.

item.title: Tigers are raising cubs in Rajasthan's Kailadevi sanctuary for the first time in nearly 30 years: 8 cubs in 5 years
item.description: A WWF-India and Rajasthan Forest Department study confirms tigers are breeding beyond Ranthambore.

item.title: Indian Navy commandos free all 20 crew of a hijacked Iranian fishing boat off Somalia, with no injuries
item.description: INS Kolkata and Air Force-airlifted marine commandos ended the hijack more than 3,000 km from Mumbai.

item.title: Ladakh grows saffron on restored barren land, harvesting 22 g in the first four days
item.description: Flowers bloomed in under 30 days in Leh, pointing to a new source of income in the cold desert.

item.title: A BARC scientist's Nisargruna plant turns a tonne of kitchen waste into about 150 kg of manure in 24–48 hours, now in Goa's Bicholim
item.description: The technology from the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre is set to spread to more Goa towns and villages.

item.title: Chennai startup EarthFokus has helped 130+ buildings save over 5 billion litres of water by catching hidden leaks
item.description: Born during Chennai's 2019 water crisis and incubated at IIT Madras, it uses smart meters and AI to spot waste.

item.title: A Gurugram Class 12 student built SkyQi, a free site that rates light pollution from a phone photo; people in 63 countries use it
item.description: Suhani Gupta's tool has collected nearly 1,200 night-sky photos from more than 490 people.

item.title: Two fishermen pull a cruise ship pianist from the Pacific after about nine hours treading water
item.description: The 37-year-old went overboard in the night; the fishing boat spotted him about 20 miles off California around noon.

item.title: Floods strand a 38-year-old chimp on an island, so his sanctuary delivers bananas by drone
item.description: Staff at Florida's Save the Chimps made sure Kaleb didn't miss a meal until the water went down.

item.title: Researchers find 280 Ice Age engravings that tourists walked past for decades in a Catalan cave
item.description: The drawings include 55 animals; before this, only two such images were known in all of Catalonia.

item.title: Temple row widens: Deepinder Goyal denies paid promotion, Ranveer Allahbadia says he is not an investor in the ₹85,000 wearable
item.description: The fight over Goyal's brain-blood-flow wearable has moved from science to influencer disclosures, with liver specialist 'TheLiverDoc' asking who is backing it and why.

item.title: Anthropic sets IPO price at $70–78 a share, valuing the Claude maker at up to $1.4 trillion
item.description: An updated filing on 10 November puts 825 million shares on offer, with Nasdaq trading under the ticker 'ANT' expected around 19 November.

item.title: Kalyan Jewellers' Q2 profit jumps 64% to ₹427 crore as revenue crosses ₹10,000 crore
item.description: The jeweller's September quarter beat estimates, though a one-time land sale added about ₹73 crore to the profit.

item.title: Ramayana: Part 1 crosses ₹823 crore worldwide in six days and becomes the first Indian film to top the UK box office
item.description: Sacnilk puts the India net total at ₹440 crore after a ₹94 crore Tuesday, while the film set overseas records for an Indian release.

item.title: Blue Tokai crosses ₹500 crore in revenue, but its loss widens 54% to ₹83 crore
item.description: The coffee chain's sales jumped nearly 60% in FY26 as it opened more cafés, but costs grew even faster.

item.title: SoftBank swings to a $7 billion loss, but Lenskart and Meesho add $394 million in gains as Ola Electric slips
item.description: SoftBank's first quarterly loss in about two years came from US data-centre costs, while two of its Indian bets kept climbing.

item.title: ShareChat parent crosses ₹1,000 crore in revenue as microdrama app QuickTV takes off
item.description: Mohalla Tech's FY26 revenue grew about 40%, and it says it turned EBITDA-positive in the June quarter.

item.title: Matrimony.com's Q2 profit rises 2.7 times to ₹20.7 crore; it will also buy more of astrology matchmaker Astro-Vision
item.description: The matchmaking company added 3.02 lakh paid subscriptions in the quarter, up about 27% from a year ago.

item.title: SEBI clears MakeMyTrip's India IPO; the share sale could raise over $1 billion
item.description: The Nasdaq-listed travel company will sell part of its Indian unit to local investors, but the unit gets no new money.

item.title: D2C brands bagged one in three startup funding deals in October, led by Boldfit's $42 million
item.description: Even as overall startup funding fell to $678 million, consumer brands raised about $200 million ahead of the festive and wedding season.

item.title: October retail inflation may have crossed RBI's 6% ceiling, economists say; official data due Thursday
item.description: Polls point to a reading of about 6%, up from 5.5% in September, as food costs climb. The official number comes out on 12 November.

item.title: India's unemployment rate eases to 5.1% in July–September, government survey shows
item.description: Joblessness for people aged 15 and over fell from 5.4% in the April–June quarter, helped by a drop in rural unemployment.

item.title: Sheikh Hasina's lawyers seek a new Bangladeshi passport; Dhaka says no and repeats its extradition demand
item.description: The former PM, who has lived in India since August 2024, has said she wants to return home in December. Bangladesh says she must come back through extradition.

item.title: Govt extends ₹2,700 crore PLI scheme for medical devices to 2035–36 and invites new applications
item.description: Manufacturers will get three years to set up factories, and the minimum sales level needed to claim incentives has been dropped.

item.title: Delhi gets a river cruise on the Yamuna: 40-minute rides between Sonia Vihar and Jagatpur for ₹500
item.description: Union minister Sarbananda Sonowal launched the service on 10 November with Delhi CM Rekha Gupta.

item.title: COP31 leaders' summit opens in Antalya today, with about 102 heads of state and government expected
item.description: Leaders will set out their national climate plans on 11–12 November. PM Modi is not expected to attend; Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav leads India's team.

item.title: Russia and Ukraine agree to a large prisoner swap on day one of US-led Abu Dhabi talks; up to 1,500 each discussed
item.description: In their first US-brokered talks since February, the two sides spoke for nearly four hours. Zelenskyy called the session 'constructive'. A second day of talks is under way.

item.title: Trump says the Iran war is 'effectively over', but keeps the naval blockade; Brent briefly dips below $90
item.description: Iran called the remarks 'fake news' and says it will not talk until its seven conditions are met. Oil fell as traders bet the fighting is winding down.

item.title: China's trade surplus passes $1 trillion for the second year running, with two months still to go
item.description: October exports jumped 35.2% from a year earlier, driven by demand for AI and data-centre equipment.

item.title: Markets reopen after the Diwali break with GIFT Nifty up 297 points; foreign investors have put in ₹53,739 crore this month
item.description: November's foreign buying is the biggest monthly total since September 2024. Lower oil prices are also helping.

item.title: Wall Street slips after US prices rise 0.4% in October; markets now fully expect a Fed rate hike in December
item.description: The Nasdaq fell about 0.7% and the S&P 500 about 0.4% as inflation came in above forecasts. Nvidia dropped about 5.5%.

item.title: Anthropic takes on Microsoft and Google with Claude Sheets, Whiteboards and Meetings
item.description: Claude can now build spreadsheets, sketch plans on shared boards and sit in on Google Meet calls, days before Anthropic's IPO.

item.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon, its 'strongest model', to AI Ultra users and developers at $2 per million tokens
item.description: After a limited preview for cyber defenders in October, Carbon is now in the Gemini app, AI Mode in Search and the API.

item.title: OpenAI launches 'Businesses in ChatGPT': brands can claim verified profiles and run their own agents
item.description: Companies get a blue tick, a dashboard showing how often ChatGPT mentions them, and, in the US, a customer-service agent inside ChatGPT.

item.title: Google's Pixel Tag, its answer to the AirTag, goes on sale today; India price ₹3,799
item.description: The Bluetooth tracker costs $29 in the US, and a four-pack is ₹12,900 in India.

item.title: Rain washes out 3rd ODI in Hamilton: India can't lose the series now; Shreyas Iyer to lead in the last two games
item.description: Not a ball was bowled at Seddon Park on 10 November, so India stay 2-0 up and New Zealand's 11-series home winning run is over.

item.title: Manu Bhaker, Esha Singh and Divya Subbaraju win 25m pistol team gold at the shooting World Championship in Doha
item.description: The trio scored 1761 to beat South Korea by 13 points, India's second gold of the championship; the men's 50m rifle 3-positions team added bronze.

item.title: FIFPRO World 11: Messi returns for a record 18th time, Yamal makes history, Ballon d'Or winner Kane left out
item.description: Nearly 20,000 professional footballers voted for the 2026 men's team of the year, announced on 9 November.

item.title: OTT this week: Rings of Power Season 3, Kareena's Daayra on Netflix, and Bengali thriller Mrigaya 1.5
item.description: Prime Video has The Rings of Power today and Jailer 2 tomorrow; Friday brings Daayra, Student of the Year: After Dark and Mrigaya 1.5.

item.title: Suriya's Scene crosses ₹100 crore India gross in five days, ₹174 crore worldwide
item.description: Jithu Madhavan's Diwali action comedy is Suriya's third hit of 2026, after Karuppu and Vishwanath & Sons.

item.title: 33 Sundarbans villagers, including 10 women, train to keep people and tigers safe
item.description: The new volunteers join a network of 98 'first responders' in Kultali, South 24 Parganas, who step in when a tiger strays into a village.

item.title: India's Dr Reddy's wins first US FDA nod for a $40-a-year generic HIV-prevention shot
item.description: The Hyderabad drugmaker's version of lenacapavir, an injection given just twice a year, is meant for 120 low- and middle-income countries.

item.title: An Assam father and daughter turn rhino and elephant dung into notebooks
item.description: Since 2014, their venture Elrhino has made paper products from wildlife waste, giving villagers near habitats an extra income.

item.title: From 27 sewing machines to steady factory jobs: Aarey's Warli women are earning with PF and medical cover
item.description: Adivasi women from Mumbai's Aarey forest, whose hamlets shrank after the Metro car-shed project, now draw regular salaries at an Andheri factory.

item.title: Mumbai doctors give a 6-kg baby a new liver in a 10-hour surgery, with his mother as donor
item.description: The one-year-old had advanced liver disease from a rare genetic disorder; he went home after 15 days.

item.title: 300+ volunteers on foot and horseback find a 6-year-old boy with autism safe after 2 nights in Kentucky woods
item.description: Roman Heilman walked out of the brush with his dog onto a horse trail, about a mile and a half from home.

item.title: The world's driest desert bursts into its biggest bloom in 30 years, with 200+ species in flower
item.description: Record rains brought by a strong El Niño woke seeds and bulbs that had slept in Chile's Atacama sand for decades.

item.title: Newborn deaths in Flint fell by half after families got cash during pregnancy and infancy
item.description: A study in JAMA Pediatrics links the Rx Kids programme to a sharp drop in babies dying in their first month.

item.title: One of Australia's most mysterious bats turns up 400 miles from where it was last seen
item.description: A scientist's handheld detector picked up the call of the rare Arnhem sheath-tailed bat at a Northern Territory sanctuary.
